verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no dedicated full-account export in open formats for leaving the platform. The 'flexible data export' is scoped to team-performance reporting, so it is an adjacent feature. The REST API's paginated JSON and the MCP server for telemetry are developer building blocks or access paths, not a documented export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
